set.text: Doctors say that students between thirteen and eighteen need eight to ten hours of sleep. However, many students sleep only six or seven hours because they study late or use their phones in bed. A lack of sleep makes it hard to pay attention in class, and it can also change a person's mood. To sleep better, experts suggest a few simple habits. First, go to bed at the same time every night. Second, keep your room dark and quiet. Finally, turn off your phone an hour before bed. These small changes help many young people feel better the next day.
